title: Budget sleep-tracking fitness ring (stripped)
idea: A $49 sleep and HRV tracking ring for consumers in a fast-growing emerging region, priced far under the established premium product in the category. A single contract manufacturer abroad produces every unit, on net-60 terms. The device runs white-label firmware from that same manufacturer, paired with a cross-platform companion app; a $3/month subscription optionally unlocks an automated sleep-coaching feature. The first batch of 5,000 units was pre-ordered through a social feed. There is no medical certification; it is sold as a wellness product. Battery life is advertised at 5 days. Returns are handled by a 2-person team in one city, shipping replacements from a home warehouse.
focus_notes: Margin vs returns and logistics at $49
Support ops cannot scale with viral demand
